title: Bohemian Chic Living Room with Macramé and Earthy Tones
description: A free-spirited Bohemian living room filled with earthy tones, macramé wall hangings, and layered rugs. Potted plants, colorful cushions, and handmade decor create a relaxed, artsy atmosphere full of personal character.

title: Industrial Loft with Exposed Brick and Metal Accents
description: An industrial-style loft living room with exposed brick walls, metal accents, and concrete flooring. Reclaimed wood furniture and large windows enhance the urban, raw aesthetic, creating a modern, minimalist space.

title: Scandinavian Living Room with Light Wood and Cozy Textures
description: A Scandinavian-inspired living room featuring light wood furniture, soft textures, and a clean, airy aesthetic. Muted colors, cozy throws, and minimalist decor create a comfortable, functional space that feels calm and inviting.

title: Victorian Parlor with Velvet Accents and Dark Wood
description: An opulent Victorian-inspired living room with velvet furniture, dark wood details, and ornate wall moldings. Crystal chandeliers, gold accents, and rich colors make this a space with historic charm and regal elegance.

title: Coastal Beach House with Whitewashed Wood and Seafoam Accents
description: A bright and airy coastal living room with whitewashed wood walls, seafoam accents, and natural rattan furniture. Beach-inspired decor, soft blues, and woven baskets give the space a breezy, relaxed vibe.

title: Mid-Century Modern with Clean Lines and Retro Colors
description: A mid-century modern living room featuring clean lines, retro colors, and sleek wood furniture. Iconic pieces like the Eames chair and starburst clock create a stylish, timeless appeal reminiscent of the 1950s and 60s.

title: Tropical Jungle Room with Leafy Greenery and Rattan Furniture
description: A lush, tropical-inspired living room with an abundance of leafy green plants, rattan furniture, and bamboo accents. Earthy colors and organic textures create a vibrant indoor jungle atmosphere.

title: Urban Minimalist with Black and White Color Scheme
description: A sleek urban minimalist living room with a monochromatic black-and-white color scheme. Simple, modern furniture, open space, and bold contrasts give this room a sophisticated, contemporary look.

title: Rustic Scandinavian Cabin with Exposed Logs and Cozy Layers
description: A rustic Scandinavian cabin-inspired living room featuring exposed wooden logs, cozy layers, and natural materials. Soft wool blankets, candle lanterns, and a fireplace create a warm, welcoming retreat.

title: High-Tech Smart Room with Sleek Furniture and LED Lighting
description: A futuristic high-tech living room featuring smart home gadgets, sleek minimalist furniture, and customizable LED lighting. Integrated screens and touch-free controls make this room cutting-edge and stylish.
